caption: Diagram 7 Maximum height of buildings | BUILDINGS
description: Diagram 7, "Maximum height of buildings", shows a five-box flowchart over three tables and a notes block. The flowchart runs: "Read map wind speed V from Figure 1 Diagram 6"; "Find the orographic zone for the site from Figure 2 Diagram 6 and obtain Factor O from Table a (or use Figure 3 Diagram 6)"; "Obtain value of Factor A from Table b"; "Calculate value of Factor S from: S = V × O × A"; "Obtain maximum allowable building height from Table c". Table a (Factor O) rows the four orographic categories, from Category 1 "Nominally flat terrain, average slope < 1/20" to Category 4 "Steep terrain, average slope > 1/5", against columns Zone 1, Zone 2, Zone 3 (1.0/1.0/1.0 to 1.36/1.20/1.15). Table b (Factor A) matches Site altitude (m) 0–500 to Factor A 1.00–1.50. Table c, "Maximum allowable building height in metres", lists Factor S (≤25–44) beside height figures under Country sites and Town sites, by Distance to the coast: < 2km, 2 to 20km, > 50km. The notes set Factor O = 1.0 outside Table a, an altitude-base option for Table b, a 300m town-edge rule (assumed country terrain) and a 1km inland-water rule for Table c, and allow interpolation in Tables b and c.
